thread:
maeves: kicking off even/odd-zone rollout — US even zones first. target: 5% traffic -> hold -> evaluate.
jay: noted. capacity cushion target = 20% for first hold. please call if <15%.
deploy-bot: Rollout started | slice=us-even | version=2026.03.21-rc3 | traffic=5% | canary=true
oliver: warm pools reporting: us-west-gpu-pool-3 warm=12 nodes, idle=3, avg-latency=72ms
ana: pinning eu models to v2026.03.20 for EU until we validate quality. if we need to failover, eu will keep pinned variant.
tim: where are the release notes? need to share with infra + cs for the window.
maeves: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21-rc3 — brief notes in the top, cs blurb at bottom. sending to #customer-success now.
jay: thumbs on metrics we care about: p99 latency, request queue depth, GPU mem % and token/sec. set alert if p99 > 450ms or queue depth > 6.
sre-oncall: I've wired the temporary alert rule to notify #eng-oncall and SMS at thresholds above. will mute non-essential alerts for the next 30m.
deploy-bot: Progress update | slice=us-even | traffic=5% -> 10% traffic (ramp step) | time=+8m | health=ok
oliver: gpu-util snapshots: us-west-gpu-pool-3 util=63% mem=72% kv-cache-hit=18%
ana: quick QA note: a small hallucination delta on EU can happen if we switch to rc3. that's why EU stays pinned until we run evals.
maeves: cool. plan: hold 10m at 10% then go to 25% if all green. rollback criteria: sustained p99 > 450ms for >5m OR error rate >1%.
jay: logging checklist done. added an emergency rollback runbook link in thread.
tim: ops window reminder — change window ends in 2h (we should be fully ramped before then or schedule a follow-up).
maeves: agree. if APAC needs staggered window, we'll bank it for their morning. APAC warmup: start with minimal traffic 2% and parallel warm-pool spin.
deploy-bot: Canary step complete | slice=us-even | traffic=25% | health=ok | note=slight increase in token/time but within SLAs
oliver: starting APAC warmup now: apac-east warm nodes provisioning (estimate 6m). current pool warm=2 nodes.
sre-oncall: monitoring queue depth for apac. will post a heatmap if anything trends up.
jay: pre-approved throttle policy if GPU mem > 85% -> scale-up or throttle new traffic (hold rollout).
ana: if we hit a quality regression in EU after unpin, we revert EU traffic to pinned model and open a patch release.
maeves: decision point: after APAC warmup completes, we run the odd zones in US (5% -> 25%) and then EU unpin trial. calling the hold at +20m to review.
tim: FYI sent to execs and CS. adding note that rollback path is immediate pin to stable + rollback tag deployment.
deploy-bot: Rollout status snapshot | us-even=25% | us-odd=0% | eu=pinned | apac=warming (2/8 nodes) | alerts=none
maeves: sounds good. set the next check-in for +20m. if anything trips, tag with :rotating_light: and we execute rollback runbook.
ana: ACK. I'll run quick evals once eu unpin is attempted.
oliver: APAC pool now warm=6 nodes, idle=2, avg-latency=88ms. ready for slice start when you are.
sre-oncall: all monitoring dashboards green. no anomalous traces yet.
maeves: ok launching US odd zones at 5% now. deploy-bot please follow same ramp steps.
deploy-bot: Rollout started | slice=us-odd | version=2026.03.21-rc3 | traffic=5%
jay: standing by to throttle if queue depth creeps > 6 or gpu mem > 80%.
maeves: thanks team. next check-in in 10m. keep replies short here unless we need to escalate. :white_check_mark:
